images.alt: Announcement square graphic with a light grey background and a dark blue bell icon above a white rounded panel. Bold heading reads ‘ANNOUNCEMENT’. Below, text states: ‘The Mental Health Bill has passed its third reading in Parliament. The Bill repeals and replaces the Mental Health (Compulsory Assessment and Treatment) Act 1992.’ At the bottom are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

post.text:
The Mental Health Bill has passed its third reading in Parliament. 

The new legislation will modernise compulsory mental health care, strengthen protections, support decision-making, and increase family and whānau involvement. 

 More information below.
